acs.text: Searching the web shop for a term shows only products whose name contains the term, and a caption "Searched for: <term>".
outcomes: every product shown has a name that contains the term (letter case ignored, G7)

acs.text: GET /products/search?q=<term> returns 200 with only products whose name contains the term, regardless of letter case (searching "PLIERS" finds the same products as "pliers").
outcomes: every product in data has a name that contains the term (letter case ignored)
searching "PLIERS" finds the same products as "pliers"

acs.text: A search without matches shows "There are no products found." on the web shop, and the API returns 200 with an empty data list and total 0.
outcomes: web shop shows "There are no products found."

acs.text: Choosing "Price (Low - High)" on the web shop lists the products by ascending price; GET /products?sort=price,asc returns the products in ascending price order.
outcomes: after choosing "Price (Low - High)" the web shop lists the products by ascending price
GET /products?sort=price,asc returns the products in ascending price order

acs.text: Filtering the web shop by the category "Hammer" shows only hammers; GET /products?by_category=<id of Hammer> returns only products in that category.
outcomes: with the "Hammer" filter the web shop shows only hammers (every product shown is in the "Hammer" category, G4)
GET /products?by_category=<id of Hammer> returns only products in that category

acs.text: Results are paginated with 12 products per page (per_page 12) on the web shop and in the API.
outcomes: the web shop shows 12 products per page (when more than 12 products exist)
API data holds 12 products on a full page

acs.text: An empty search (no term) returns all products, so the mobile app can reuse the search endpoint for its "All tools" screen.
outcomes: a search with no term returns all products (total equals the total of the unfiltered catalogue list GET /products, G6)

rules.text: GET /products and GET /products/search both return { current_page, data: [products], per_page, total, last_page }
GET /products lists products, takes sort and by_category parameters and is paginated; GET /products/search?q=<term> searches
The web shop and the public catalogue API must behave the same way

oracleGaps.value: the empty search's total equals the total of the unfiltered catalogue list GET /products (same run)
letter case is ignored when checking that a product name contains the term
